user_query.title: Install Caffe 1.0.0 and Train CIFAR-10 CNN
user_query.text: Install the original BVLC Caffe deep learning framework version 1.0.0, clone it to /app/caffe, and build it for CPU-only execution. Train a convolutional neural network to classify CIFAR-10 images for exactly 500 iterations using the solver configuration at examples/cifar10/cifar10_quick_solver.prototxt. Write the training output to /app/caffe/training_output.txt, and verify that the test accuracy over 100 iterations is no more than 5% less than the train accuracy and is greater than 45%. The resulting model file must be available in the examples/cifar10 directory and named cifar10_quick_iter_{number_of_iterations}.caffemodel.

previous_summary: Installed Caffe 1.0.0 CPU-only at /app/caffe on Ubuntu 24.04 (patching protobuf io.cpp, disabling OpenCV), built it, downloaded CIFAR-10, created LMDBs, hand-computed mean.binaryproto in Python since compute_image_mean needs OpenCV, set solver to max_iter 500/CPU, and launched training to /app/caffe/training_output.txt; at last poll it reached iteration 300 (loss 1.39) around 00:44, still running.
